title: A Space-owned Circle opens on its own design cover, with a Part of Space pill

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: the live Circle page is NOT the Circles design; he gave the phrase rewrite probe SCAN-881

verify.evidence: Probe fails on main (FqCircleSpaceHeader stacked above the Circle, shell strips the cover under a Space) and passes here.

detail: SCAN-881 (14 Oct) put a Space's full header above every Space-owned Circle and turned the Circle's own cover photo, tags and badge off under it, so the page read as a Space page with a plain card under it and nothing like the design. The Circle layout no longer renders FqCircleSpaceHeader (component deleted); the shell always draws the design cover with its h1, tags, badge and actions, and a Part of <Space> pill over the cover links to the owning Space. Follow and Boost stay on the Space's own pages. Owner phrase given 2026-10-28: rewrite probe SCAN-881.
